final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day FROM film GROUP BY rating), c AS (SELECT AVG(per_day) AS overall FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(r.per_day) AS avg_per_day_rate, AVG(r.per_day - c.overall) AS avg_excess_over_overall FROM r, c WHERE r.per_day > c.overall
